Accurate: Boosts throw accuracy on deep passes.
Acrobat: Boosts spectacular/contested catches while off-balance or falling.
All Day: Reduces stamina drain and keeps blocking/tackling ratings from fading as the game wears on.
Ankle Breaker: Boosts juke move success rate for making defenders miss in the open field.
Backfield Mismatch: Boosts route running and catching for a running back split out or lined up in the slot.
Balance Beam: Boosts break-tackle on stumble recoveries, keeping a runner upright after contact.
Boomer: Boosts kickoff power for more touchbacks and shorter returns.
Brick Wall: Boosts run blocking, making the blocker harder to move off his spot.
Coffin Corner: Boosts punt accuracy for pinning the return team deep near their own goal line.
Comeback: Boosts core passing/receiving ratings for the whole offense when trailing in the 4th quarter.
Deep Out Elite: Boosts route running and separation on deep out-breaking routes.
Edge Threat: Boosts finesse pass-rush moves for defenders rushing off the edge.
Escape Artist: Boosts a quarterback's ability to slip pressure and extend the play outside the pocket.
Evasive: Boosts elusiveness (spin/juke) for a ball carrier in the open field.
Goal Line Back: Boosts trucking and break-tackle power near the goal line and on short-yardage runs.
Grab-N-Go: Boosts acceleration out of the catch/handoff into the first few steps of a run.
Gunslinger: Reduces the accuracy penalty for off-platform and across-the-body throws.
Home Run: Boosts top speed for a ball carrier once he breaks into the open field.
Human Joystick: Boosts agility and change-of-direction for sharper cuts.
Ice the Kicker: Reduces the opposing kicker's accuracy in high-pressure, late-game field goal attempts.
Inside Focus: Boosts catching in traffic over the middle of the field.
Juke Box: Boosts juke move success for a ball carrier.
Jump Ball: Boosts contested/50-50 catch ability against a defender in coverage.
Lead The Way: Boosts a lead blocker's ability to seal a block in the open field.
Linchpin: Boosts pass-block anchor against power rush moves.
Lurker: Boosts zone-coverage reaction and ball-hawking instincts for reading the quarterback.
Man to Man: Boosts man coverage, staying tighter to a receiver through the route.
Master Tactician: Boosts play recognition, reacting faster once the play develops.
Matchup Nightmare: Boosts route running and separation for a tight end working against a linebacker or safety.
Mid In Elite: Boosts route running and separation on mid-range in-breaking routes.
Mid Zone KO: Boosts a pass rusher's ability to disrupt throwing lanes and get pressure through the middle.
Nasty Streak: Boosts pass-rush moves that compound the more consecutive good reps a lineman strings together.
Natural Talent: Gives a young player a general ratings boost beyond what his current development trait alone would suggest.
Out My Way: Boosts stiff arm and trucking against smaller defenders trying to make an open-field tackle.
Pass Lead Elite: Boosts accuracy leading a receiver in stride on deep and intermediate throws.
Pass Protector: Boosts overall pass-block technique for an offensive lineman.
Pick Artist: Boosts interception/ball-skill ratings for a defensive back playing the ball in the air.
Playmaker: Boosts separation and catching in traffic on third down and other high-leverage plays.
Possession Catch: Boosts reliable catching on routine, low-difficulty targets — fewer drops on the easy ones.
Post Up: Boosts a receiver's ability to box out and shield a defender from the ball.
Power Kick: Boosts kick power for field goals and kickoffs.
Quick Draw: Speeds up a quarterback's throw release.
RAC: Boosts yards-after-catch ability for a receiver or tight end.
Racetrack: Boosts acceleration and straight-line speed for a ball carrier once he's in the open field.
Return Man: Boosts vision and speed on kickoff and punt returns.
Rip Artist: Boosts the rip pass-rush move for beating a blocker inside.
Route Technician: Boosts precision on route breaks, creating more consistent separation.
Run Stopper: Boosts a defender's ability to shed a block and make the tackle at the point of attack against the run.
Scrambler: Boosts a quarterback's speed and elusiveness when running the ball himself.
Secure Protector: Boosts anchor strength in pass protection against power rushers.
Shutdown: Locks down whichever receiver a cornerback is matched up against, sharply reducing their catch rate.
Special Teams Ace: Boosts blocking and coverage ratings across kickoff and punt units.
Spin Cycle: Boosts spin-move success for a ball carrier.
Stiff Arm: Boosts stiff-arm success for shedding an arm-tackle attempt.
Tank: Boosts trucking power for breaking arm tackles through contact.
Truck: Boosts truck-move power for running through defenders instead of around them.
Truzz: Boosts tackling and run-support ratings for a defensive back or linebacker closing on the ball carrier.
Unstoppable Force: Gives an interior defensive lineman a major pass-rush power boost that only a double team can reliably slow down.
Virtuoso: Gives a kicker a major accuracy and power boost, especially under late-game pressure.
Wrecking Ball: Gives a ball carrier a major trucking and break-tackle boost while the ability is active.
YAC'Em Up: Boosts yards-after-catch ability, especially on short and crossing routes.
Zone KO: Boosts zone-coverage reactions and ball skills for jumping routes and playing the pass.
Edge Protector: Boosts pass-block technique for a tackle protecting against speed rushers off the edge.
Identifier: Boosts pre-snap play recognition for a defender diagnosing the offense's call.
Puller Elite: Boosts blocking effectiveness on pulling assignments for a guard or center leading a run play.
Focused Kicker: Boosts kick consistency and accuracy under normal conditions.
Zen Kicker: Reduces the accuracy penalty a kicker takes from crowd noise and hostile road environments.
Clutch Kicker: Boosts kick accuracy in late-game, high-pressure situations.
Edge Threat Elite: A stronger version of Edge Threat — bigger finesse pass-rush boost off the edge.
Strip Specialist: Boosts forced-fumble chance when making a tackle.
Inside Stuff: Boosts a defensive lineman's ability to stop interior/gap runs at the point of attack.
El Toro: Boosts trucking power for running through contact — same family as Tank and Truck.
Unpredictable: Makes a ball carrier's cuts harder for the defense to anticipate and react to.
Bruiser: Boosts blocking power for a lineman or blocker at the point of attack.
Reach For It: Boosts diving-catch range for a receiver or tight end.
Flat Zone KO: Boosts a defender's reactions covering the flat and short zones.
Honorary Lineman: Boosts run-blocking for a non-lineman (tight end or fullback) asked to block like one.
Deep In Elite: Boosts route running and separation on deep in-breaking routes.
Slot-O-Matic: Boosts route running and separation for a receiver working out of the slot.
Hot Route Master: Boosts the effectiveness of a quarterback's pre-snap hot-route adjustments.
Pocket Deadeye: Boosts short-to-intermediate throw accuracy while standing tall in the pocket.
Set Feet Lead: Boosts accuracy leading a receiver in stride when the quarterback has his feet set.
Fearless: Reduces the accuracy and composure penalty a quarterback takes when throwing under pressure.
Deep Range Deadeye: Boosts accuracy on deep throws made from a clean pocket.
One Cut: Boosts burst and speed on a runner's first cut after taking the handoff.
Clutch: Boosts overall performance in close games and late-game situations.
Backfield Master: Boosts blitz pickup and recognition for a running back in pass protection.
First One Free: Softens the impact of the first unblocked rusher getting to the quarterback on a passing play.
Power Specialist: Boosts power pass-rush moves for beating a blocker with strength.
No Outsiders: Boosts coverage on outside-breaking and perimeter routes for a defender.
One Step Ahead: Boosts a defender's initial reaction and jump at the snap.
Bench Press: Boosts point-of-attack strength for stacking and shedding blocks.
Punt Elite: Boosts overall punt distance and accuracy.
Freight Train: Boosts trucking power for a ball carrier running downhill through contact.
Long Range Deadeye: Boosts accuracy on the longest throws down the field.
Outside Apprentice: A development-stage ratings boost for a player still growing into outside-breaking routes or coverage.
TE Apprentice: A development-stage ratings boost for a young tight end still growing into the position.
Under Pressure: Reduces the accuracy and composure penalty a quarterback takes from an incoming rusher.
Deep Route KO: Boosts a defender's reactions covering deep routes.
Deep Zone KO: Boosts a defender's reactions and ball skills in deep zone coverage.
Omaha: Boosts the effectiveness of a quarterback's pre-snap audibles and hot routes at the line.
Protected: Reduces a quarterback's chance of fumbling when hit or sacked.
